function: Provide a list of data entry status of modeling for a quick reference. The list may come in handy when the progress of modeling is evaluated and the current model data are compared with other model data.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [Project] tab > [Management] group > [Project Status] Shortcut key : [Ctrl]+T
usage: Display the status of data entry for each item. Where applicable, provide the number of data entries.
